purpose: Proves direct-edit reconciliation: when the user has made a direct edit recorded in direct_edits.json, a subsequent agent edit that overwrites that user-owned span WITHOUT reconciling against the recorded direct edit fails the oracle.
required_evidence: direct_edits.json record (path, span/anchor, user content, timestamp)
fresh-read of file at agent edit time
agent tool_call old_string/new_string targeting the same span
whether the agent's old_string matches the user's current content (reconciled) or a stale pre-user-edit value (clobber)
file after-state vs recorded user content

reconciliation.outcome: agent overwrote the user's direct edit using a stale baseline

rationale: The user directly changed the hero title to 'Acme Freight Co.' (recorded in direct_edits.json). The agent's exact_replace targets the pre-user-edit text 'Welcome to Acme', meaning it edited from a stale baseline and would discard the user's direct edit. Direct-edit reconciliation requires the agent to read fresh and respect recorded user edits, so the oracle returns fail.
